prompt: Generate a commissioning checklist for leftover torch-applied waterproofing before backfill.
answer:
Here is the pre-backfill commissioning checklist for the torch-applied waterproofing, built around the Khor spec hold point and mandatory Engineer witness.

- **4 mm SBS, 100 mm laps** — spec limits are non-negotiable per KHOR-WP-SPEC-TOKEN-33107.
- **Engineer witness + hold point** — backfill is locked until the Engineer signs the release; this is the single critical-path gate.
- **Seven check stages** — from substrate to backfill release, with three hard hold points (substrate, holiday test, backfill).
- **Holiday / spark test** — zero-tolerance acceptance; any pinhole is repaired and re-tested before protection board goes on.
- **Protection board is pre-condition** — no excavator tracks on bare membrane; damage after sign-off voids the warranty.

### Next actions
1. **QC Manager:** Verify 4 mm SBS mill certs and primer TDS are on site before first WIR submission. *(Due: Pre-start)*
2. **Site Engineer:** Submit WIR for substrate inspection 48 hrs ahead; re-submit after any rain event. *(Due: Ongoing)*
3. **PM:** Brief backfill crew that Step 7 sign-off is required; unauthorized backfill is a stop-work offense. *(Due: Pre-backfill mobilization)*
4. **Contracts:** Log Engineer witness attendance at each hold point for payment milestone evidence. *(Due: Monthly)*

---

## COMMISSIONING CHECKLIST — TORCH-APPLIED WATERPROOFING (PRE-BACKFILL)
**Project Reference:** KHOR-WP-SPEC-TOKEN-33107  
**System:** 4 mm Torch-Applied SBS Membrane  
**Hold Point:** Backfill Release | **Witness:** Engineer required  

| Step | Item | Acceptance Criteria | Standard / Spec | Witness | Sign-off |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 1 | Substrate Condition | Concrete cured, dry, free of laitance, frost, standing water. No sharp protrusions. | Manufacturer method statement; Khor Spec | QC / Engineer | Installer / QC |
| 2 | Primer Application | Even coat, full coverage. Tack window observed before torching. No ponding. | Manufacturer TDS | QC | Installer / QC |
| 3 | Membrane Verification | 4 mm torch-applied SBS confirmed. Mill certs match batch on site. | Khor Spec; TDS | Engineer | QC / Engineer |
| 4 | Lap Width & Torching | 100 mm minimum laps (side and end). Continuous bitumen bleed on seam. No fish-mouths, blisters, cold joints. | Khor Spec (100 mm laps); Manufacturer TDS | Engineer | Installer / QC / Engineer |
| 5 | Holiday / Spark Test | Zero holidays on completed sheet. Spark test or flood test per ASTM D4787 / manufacturer. | ASTM D4787; Manufacturer | Engineer | QC / Engineer |
| 6 | Protection Board | Protection board installed per spec. No tracked plant on bare membrane. No damage post-test. | Project Spec | QC | Installer / QC |
| 7 | **Backfill Release (HOLD POINT)** | Steps 1–6 complete and signed. Engineer sign-off recorded. | ITP Hold Point; Khor Spec | **Engineer** | QC
